params.description: Project ID to exclude users who are already associated with this project (direct members, workspace members, or implicit admin/owner access).

params.name: exclude_workspace_id
params.description: Workspace ID to exclude users who are already associated with this workspace (direct workspace members or implicit admin/owner access).

params.name: ordering
params.description: Which field to use when ordering the results.

params.name: page
params.description: A page number within the paginated result set.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Number of results to return per page.

params.name: role
params.description:
Filter members by organization role. Accepts single role or comma-separated list of roles.

**Format:**
- Single role: `?role=RE`
- Multiple roles: `?role=AN,RE` (users with ANY of these roles)

**Role Codes:**
- `OW` = Owner
- `AD` = Administrator
- `MA` = Manager
- `RE` = Reviewer
- `AN` = Annotator
- `NO` = Not Activated
- `DI` = Disabled

params.name: scope
params.description: Member visibility scope. `accessible` (default) limits Managers to members in their projects/workspaces. `all` returns all organization members. Only affects Manager role.

params.name: tags
params.description: Filter members by tags. Use a comma-separated list of tag IDs.
